'''Ryan Hase Ral Ops DS''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Ryan Hase]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-6695">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6695 Ral Ops], DeckTech (Ryan "heinekin" Hase, 14 May 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/6695/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/6695/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018171123/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6695/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Ryan Hase]]
* '''Published:''' 14 May 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Ral Ops''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif|label=Ralltiir Operations}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor ROps Hase DS 2000 6695.txt |Download]] (omits The Anti Numbers Guy for endor(u no wut I mean): not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' This is just your same old Ral Ops deck that uses just 4 sites to get up and running before battling elsewhere to cause some major damage.

== Original post ==

'''Ral Ops'''
* '''Author:''' Ryan "heinekin" Hase
* '''Published:''' May 14, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' This is just your same old Ral Ops deck that uses just 4 sites to get up and running before battling elsewhere to cause some major damage.

=== Strategy ===

Oh kay then, it's simple to see what I'm doing here, get out 3-4 sites and put up at-st's and at-at's to hold the ground.  Since this deck is all about reacting, holding the ground is easy as hell.	Once sites are secured, fight anywhere with the +3-4 destiny and clean up.  OK, if you didn't see the super tech already, here's the deal.  Get out Death Star and have it orbit ralltiir asap.  Once you get Torent to the war room drains are +1 at ralltiir.  Booooooya  Bad Feeling + Wrong Turn is sooooo painful that's it's tech.  Obi for 10?  Then he's imp barriered?  Ouch, SHIAT.....pain....tech
